captions.caption: A firefighter in a silver proximity suit adjusts their gas mask.
The firefighter tightens the straps on the side of the mask.
The firefighter uses their gloved hand to press the mask against their face.
The firefighter continues to ensure a proper seal of the mask.
Close-up of the firefighter's eyes as they look through the clear visor.
The firefighter finishes adjusting the mask and prepares the hood.
The firefighter begins to pull the silver heat-reflective hood over their head.
The hood is pulled up, partially covering the top of the gas mask.
The firefighter adjusts the silver hood around the mask's edges.
The firefighter puts on a helmet over the silver hood.
The firefighter secures the helmet on top of the hood.
The firefighter adjusts the placement of the helmet.
The firefighter checks the side of the helmet, where a light is attached.
The firefighter uses their gloved hand to tighten the helmet strap.
The firefighter looks directly forward, fully geared up in the silver suit.
The firefighter reaches up to the gold-tinted outer visor of the helmet.
The firefighter begins lowering the gold-tinted visor.
The gold-tinted visor is fully lowered over the gas mask.
The firefighter turns their head to the left.
The firefighter turns their head to the right, checking their surroundings.
A firefighter in a full proximity suit stands near a source of thick smoke.
Thick brown and black smoke billows in the background.
The firefighter stands ready as smoke fills the training area.
Dense smoke rises from a fire just out of frame.
The smoke swirls and drifts across the training grounds.
More smoke billows up, obscuring the background structures.
The camera captures the intensity of the smoke rising from the fire.
The firefighter remains stationary, observing the smoke and fire.
A large volume of smoke continues to rise into the air.
The smoke shifts slightly in the wind as it billows upwards.
The firefighter is seen from behind, looking toward the smoke.
Firefighters in silver suits gather near a fire truck.
A stream of water is sprayed onto a firefighter for decontamination.
The firefighter is thoroughly rinsed by the water spray.
Other firefighters stand nearby, waiting for their turn or assisting.
A firefighter in a tan uniform walks across the foreground.
The water spray continues to hit the firefighter in the silver suit.
Firefighters prepare to deploy a large hose from the truck.
Two firefighters grab the hose and begin to pull it.
The firefighters pull the hose away from the fire truck.
One firefighter helps guide the hose as the other pulls.
The firefighters move the hose toward the site of the training exercise.
A firefighter walks across an open tarmac toward a small fire.
The firefighter carries a portable fire extinguisher in their right hand.
A second firefighter follows, also carrying a fire extinguisher.
The first firefighter approaches a piece of burning debris.
The fire on the ground begins to grow and produce black smoke.
The firefighter gets closer to the flames, preparing to use the extinguisher.
The fire spreads across a liquid on the tarmac surface.
The fire intensifies, creating a large plume of black smoke.
The firefighters stop a short distance from the growing fire.
Dense black smoke billows from the burning liquid.
The fire continues to expand across the wet pavement.
A wide shot shows the fire and the large amount of smoke it generates.
The firefighter starts to discharge the fire extinguisher.
The white extinguishing agent is directed at the base of the fire.
A helicopter is visible in the distance as the training continues.
The firefighter sweeps the extinguisher spray across the fire.
The flames react to the extinguishing agent, shifting and flickering.
The firefighter continues to suppress the fire with the handheld extinguisher.
